notes.title: ALPHA 0.9.0
notes.content:
New year, new update!! With a lot of new interesting content.

[b]- ADDED PIRATES [/b]
Now you will find camps with pirates guarding it on all islands, each camp will have loot but you will need to kill the pirates if you want it.
The pirates AI is on a early stage and will be improved with the updates, in future updates their will raid your base and be more smarter.

[b]- NEW FORGE MECHANIM[/b]
You will need the forge and blacksmith tools if you want to craft metal tools.

[b]- NEW ITEMS[/b]
Added sword,shield,explosives,etc.

And more...
Read the complete update note here:
[url=https://blueplant.wixsite.com/lostshipwreck/single-post/update-alpha-0-9-0]https://blueplant.wixsite.com/lostshipwreck/single-post/update-alpha-0-9-0[/url]

notes.title: ALPHA 0.8.8 Mini Update
notes.content:
A small update to fix important bugs and add some new content.

[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]

[list]
[*] TIME OF DAY ISSUE AFTER PASS THE DAY 105
[*] CANTEEN DIDN'T WORK
[*] WORKSHOP UPLOADER FIXED
[*] CRAFTING BENCH FIXED
[*] RACCOON PELT WASN'T ABLE TO ADD TO THE CRAFTING BENCH
[*] THERE WAS NO MUD AND OBSIDIAN SPAWNERS
[*] LAMP COLOR DIDN'T GET SAVE
[/list]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]

[list]
[*] NEW TRANSPORT RAFT: With this you will able to transport items and bamboo from one to other island
[*] NEW SPOILED SYSTEM FOR FOOD
[/list]

[b]IMPROVES[/b]

[list]
[*] SHARK AI IMPROVED
[*] BONFIRE NOW REGULATE THE TEMPERATURE WHEN YOU ARE COLD
[*] NOW SPEARS AND ARROWS HAVE A LIMIT USAGE
[*] NOW LIGHT HOUSES AND LAMPS TURN ON AUTOMATICALLY ON NIGHT
[*] LAMP BATTERIES INCREASED
[*] ANIMAL LOOT IMPROVED
[*] BATS NOW MAKE SOUND
[*] ENVIROMENT TEMPERATURES IMPROVED
[/list]

notes.title: ALPHA 0.1.2 RELEASED
notes.content:
HI EVERYBODY, WE FINALLY FINISHED THIS NEXT VERSION.

Fixed Bugs: 

• No more extreme head bobbing.

• Now the screen locks when you open any menu.

• Fixed the camera shaking when the player enter in the water.

• Crafting menu now can go back and forward.

• Language bugs:  Some words did not exist in languages like german or french , causing that the UI display "BAD KEY", now all the words are registered properly in each language.

• We fixed the cutted log pivot, for be more easy to manipulate in the creative mode.

• Now you can take back a lance or arrow after throw it.

AND A LOT OF MORE BUGS WERE FIXED, AND ALSO WE ADDED NEW THINGS.

CHECK THE COMPLETE NOTE HERE -->

https://blueplant.wixsite.com/lostshipwreck/single-post/2017/10/06/UPDATE-ALPHA-012
